title: Causal Factors of Anxiety and Depression in College Students: Longitudinal Ecological Momentary Assessment and Causal Analysis Using Peter and Clark Momentary Conditional Independence
limitations: - Weekly sampling may not capture rapid fluctuations in mental states; - Limited coverage of symptoms due to minimal questions; - Potential underestimation of causal effects due to time lag; - Future work needed to test moderating factors like gender and socioeconomic status.
notes: The paper does not explicitly mention preregistration. Code and data availability are declared in the paper, but supplementary materials or code repositories are not directly linked in the provided text.
